description: A tall woman crosses your floor with a fighter's economy of motion, chalk dust still on her boots and old scars laddering her forearms. Something in the set of her jaw, the particular stillness of her, is strangely familiar.
dialogue: "Kara. Arena blood, Arena training. I hear you changed the fate of the sands, and I came to see what sort of future your house offers another fighter. I fight, I work, I do not complain. Give me honest wages and you will have one of the best blades the Arena ever taught."

choices.option: Hire her at a full wage. The Arena's fight is yours too. ([COST] per day)
choices.message: You offer the full wage without haggling. Kara takes your hand with a grip like a gate hinge. 'The Arena's people said you were fair. I will enjoy confirming it.' Word that you stood by the Arena's kin travels fast (+3 Reputation).

choices.option: Negotiate: steady work at a lower wage - more left over for the sands. ([COST] per day)
choices.message: 'Less coin, steady work... a purse built over a season beats one fat night.' She runs the sum with an Arena clerk's precision, and nods once. 'Done.' She accepts a reduced daily cost ([actual_cost], a 20% discount), and the fair dealing still speaks well of your house (+2 Reputation).
Kara takes the refusal without a flicker - the family face. 'Fair enough. The sand teaches patience.' She leaves the way she came, unhurried, and you suspect this is not the last you will see of her.
